label: Dehalococcoides mccartyi 195
description: Obligate organohalide-respiring anaerobe (Chloroflexota) that catalyzes complete reductive dechlorination of tetrachloroethene (PCE) through TCE, cis-DCE, and vinyl chloride to non-toxic ethene. Terminal-step dehalogenator distinct from Geobacter which stalls at cis-DCE.

label: Dehalococcoides complete-dechlorination module
description: Sequential reductive-dehalogenase system (RdhA family): PceA (PCE to TCE), TceA (TCE to cis-DCE), VcrA and BvcA (cis-DCE and VC to ethene). Enables organohalide respiration to the terminal ethene product.

label: PceA reductive dehalogenase (Dhc)
description: First-step reductive dehalogenase; converts PCE to TCE.

label: TceA reductive dehalogenase (Dhc)
description: TCE-dechlorinating reductive dehalogenase; converts TCE to cis-DCE.

label: VcrA/BvcA reductive dehalogenase (Dhc)
description: Terminal-step reductive dehalogenase; converts cis-DCE and VC to non-toxic ethene.

label: Pseudomonas putida KT2440
description: Aerobic soil pseudomonad; workhorse organism for oxidative aromatic and PAH catabolism. Multiple ring-hydroxylating dioxygenase systems including toluene/xylene monooxygenases, naphthalene dioxygenase, and aromatic amine oxidases. Distinct from Geobacter anaerobic route.

label: KT2440 aerobic aromatic-amine oxidation module
description: Oxidative pathway for arylamines and aromatic amines using aromatic-amine dehydrogenase and monoamine oxidase homologs. Handles primary aromatic amines including aniline and 4-aminobiphenyl.

label: KT2440 PAH ring-hydroxylation module
description: Ring-hydroxylating-dioxygenase system based on todC1C2 (toluene dioxygenase) and NahAaAbAcAd (naphthalene dioxygenase) homologs. Initiates oxidative attack on aromatic hydrocarbons including benzo[a]pyrene ring systems.

label: TodC1C2 toluene dioxygenase (KT2440)
description: Ring-hydroxylating dioxygenase; initial oxidative attack on aromatic ring.

label: NdoB / naphthalene dioxygenase homolog (KT2440)
description: Naphthalene dioxygenase family enzyme active on PAH substrates including benzo[a]pyrene under some conditions.

label: Aromatic amine oxidase (KT2440)
description: Oxidative deamination of aromatic amine substrates; distinct from mammalian NAT-mediated N-acetylation.

label: Benzo[a]pyrene
description: PAH exposure anchor; canonical CYP1A1/1B1 substrate in humans, aerobic dioxygenase substrate in bacteria.

label: BaP-7,8-cis-dihydrodiol (bacterial)
description: cis-dihydrodiol product of bacterial dioxygenase attack on BaP; distinct from the CYP1A1-derived arene-oxide + trans-dihydrodiol that becomes BPDE in mammalian cells.

label: 4-Aminobiphenyl
description: Aromatic-amine bladder carcinogen; substrate for both bacterial aromatic-amine oxidase (aerobic deamination) and human CYP1A2 N-hydroxylation followed by NAT2 acetylation.

label: 4-Aminobiphenyl aromatic-amine-oxidase product
description: Bacterial aromatic-amine-oxidase-derived product; oxidative deamination distinct from mammalian N-hydroxylation/DNA-adduct pathway.

label: Rhodococcus erythropolis
description: Aerobic actinomycete with broad xenobiotic catabolism. Uses F420-dependent oxidoreductases (FDR-A/FDR-B family) to reduce the bisfuran ring of aflatoxin B1, opening the toxic lactone and disabling the CYP1A2-derived exo-8,9-epoxide bioactivation route. Distinct from mammalian bioactivation.

label: R. erythropolis AFB1-reductase module
description: F420-dependent oxidoreductase system for the reduction and detoxification of aflatoxin B1. Substrate: AFB1; product: less-toxic reduced AFB1 species.

label: F420-dependent AFB1 reductase (Rhodococcus erythropolis)
description: F420-dependent oxidoreductase family; catalyzes reductive detoxification of AFB1.

label: Rhodococcus sp. ANM-7
description: Aerobic Rhodococcus soil isolate; grows on N-nitrosodimethylamine (NDMA) as sole nitrogen source. Uses aerobic monooxygenase-mediated NDMA degradation, in contrast to the mammalian CYP2E1 route that generates methylating intermediates.

label: Rhodococcus sp. ANM-7 NDMA-degradation module
description: Aerobic monooxygenase pathway: NDMA is oxidized via propane monooxygenase-related enzymes to methylamine and formaldehyde intermediates that enter central metabolism.

label: Propane-monooxygenase homolog for NDMA (Rhodococcus sp. ANM-7)
description: Aerobic soluble propane-monooxygenase-family enzyme; initiates NDMA oxidation.

label: Aflatoxin B1
description: Mycotoxin from Aspergillus flavus and A. parasiticus; potent liver carcinogen via CYP1A2/3A4-derived exo-8,9-epoxide.

label: AFB1 F420-reduced product
description: F420-dependent bacterial reduction of the AFB1 bisfuran; downstream product cannot form the mammalian exo-8,9-epoxide.

label: N-Nitrosodimethylamine
description: Small volatile nitrosamine; potent CYP2E1 substrate in mammalian bioactivation to methylating species.

label: Methylamine
description: Aerobic bacterial catabolic intermediate downstream of NDMA oxidation.

label: Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron VPI-5482
description: Abundant colonic Bacteroidetes; two catabolic modules relevant to xenobiotic handling. Azoreductase activity reduces aromatic-amine precursors; beta-glucuronidase deconjugates host-glucuronidated substrates including AFB1-N7-guanine glucuronide, releasing free carcinogen back into the lumen.

label: B. thetaiotaomicron gut azo-reduction module
description: FMN-dependent azoreductase system; reductive cleavage of azo bonds. Handles aromatic amine precursor substrates including azo-linked benzidine and aminobiphenyl dyes.

label: B. thetaiotaomicron beta-glucuronidase deconjugation module
description: Gut microbial beta-glucuronidase (GUS) family; hydrolyzes host-conjugated glucuronides in the intestinal lumen, releasing free aglycones back for reabsorption. Relevant to AFB1 detoxification counter-currents and other host-glucuronidated carcinogens.

label: FMN-dependent azoreductase (B. thetaiotaomicron)
description: FMN-dependent azoreductase; reductive cleavage of azo bonds.

label: Beta-glucuronidase (B. thetaiotaomicron)
description: Loop-1 beta-glucuronidase; hydrolyzes glucuronide conjugates released via biliary excretion.

label: Veillonella parvula DSM 2008
description: Oral commensal (tongue biofilm) with anaerobic nitrate reductase (nap-type). Reduces salivary nitrate to nitrite; the second step (nitrite to nitric oxide and further) is oxygen-limited, so the oral cavity is not a strong endogenous nitrosation site. Provides ecosystem_outsourced reference for the nitrosamine axis.

label: V. parvula oral nitrate-reduction module
description: Periplasmic nitrate-reductase (nap-type) system; canonical driver of the entero-salivary nitrate cycle.

label: Napa periplasmic nitrate reductase (V. parvula)
description: Periplasmic nitrate reductase; nitrate to nitrite.

label: Azo-linked 4-aminobiphenyl precursor
description: Representative azo-linked aromatic-amine precursor; reductive cleavage by gut azoreductase releases free 4-ABP.

label: AFB1-N7-guanine glucuronide
description: Host-conjugated AFB1-derived glucuronide; substrate for microbial beta-glucuronidase deconjugation.

label: Nitrate
description: Dietary nitrate entering the entero-salivary cycle.

label: Nitrite
description: Reduced product of oral nitrate reduction; feeds N-nitrosation reactions in acidic stomach.
